correctness.rationale: The cocycle gives the alternating edge determinant with the stated commutator convention; basis brackets generate the full edge space. For each allowed nonzero vertex set U, contracting its zero-target edges gives a forest with c(U) components and r surviving edges: projective labels contribute (q+1)^c(U) q^r, and scalar propagation along the nonzero-target forest contributes (q-1)^(|U|-r). The input centers are unconstrained. The empty zero set proves attainment, including in characteristic two; empty and isolated components give the expected factors. Conditional subtree counts really depend only on whether the parent label is zero: the linear determinant equation at a prescribed nonzero parent gives q child labels, with one zero label precisely at target zero. Thus the two states suffice and the arithmetic bound is uniform in q, not a bit complexity claim. Direct enumeration independently agreed with the formula and recurrence on the empty forest, binary and F4 paths, and an F3 disconnected forest. The F2 path gives (76,36,24,24,36,12,24,24) before the central factor.
residual_risks: Finite replay corroborates the proof and is not exhaustive over fields or forests; O(n) counts arithmetic operations.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: For U=V minus the zero labels, the earlier term (q²−1)^c(U)(q−1)^(e(U)−r) equals (q+1)^c(U)(q−1)^(|U|−r), since e(U)=|U|−c(U). Both sum exactly over U containing the nonzero-target endpoints and multiply by q^(2m+r). This is equivalent coverage, not just the same graph parameters.
